days.note: Header read off the graphic: FRIDAY › 28. One graphic prints all three days (ULTRA 25TH ANNIVERSARY · SET TIMES, footer 12:00 PM → 12:00AM), seven stage boxes, each with a FRIDAY › 28, SATURDAY › 29 and SUNDAY › 30 column; this day is its column. The year is not printed on the graphic: the archived page that embeds it is titled "Ultra Miami Set Times - Ultra Music Festival March 28, 29, 30 – 2025". Every set prints a START only, so every row is open-ended. Stage names are the box logos, uppercased. The third box prints a different host logo over each day (amnesia IBIZA Friday, carl cox INVITED with the MEGASTRUCTURE logo Saturday, a square monogram Sunday) and is one stage, MEGASTRUCTURE; the sixth box likewise (AREA 69 Friday, AITF7A with the UMF RADIO logo Saturday, DIRTY WORKZ Sunday) is UMF RADIO. A smaller blue word after or under a name (LIVE, DJ SET, EVOLUTION, a presents line) is kept in parentheses, as printed; blue B2B and B3B join the names. ?B2B?B2B?B2B?B2B?B2B?B2B is printed as is: an unnamed set. KETBOI69 and PARTIBOI69 end in the digits 69.
